relations: While the wick burns, the flame flickers with air currents and casts a warm glow on the wood panel.
As wax melts, the purple candle shortens and a pool of wax grows at its base on the plate.
The flame persists upright above the wick as long as oxygen and melted wax feed the combustion.
The plate and wood background remain stationary beneath the lit candle throughout the burning.
